[[File:Rebel_Senior_Sergeant_SWGTCG.png|thumb|right|250px|A Rebel senior sergeant]]
'''Senior sergeant''' was a military rank used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was placed above [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and below [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]]. The Rebel rank of senior sergeant was equivalent to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Master Sergeant/Legends|master sergeant]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
